acceptance: a lane diff that adds a _test.go starting real tmux without tmuxtest.Main fails at its own ship, naming TestEveryTmuxTestPackageUsesTheOrphanGuard
the list of tree-scan guard packages is read from one data source, and a test fails when a listed package does not exist
fix: Find the code that picks the ship repo-contract backstop packages (SHIP_REPO_CONTRACT_GATE, 'importer backstop'); the file names above are a guess, so list every file you touch. Add the tree-scan guard packages (packages whose tests walk the whole tree, such as internal/tmuxtest, internal/guards, internal/repocontract) to every backstop run as data, not a hard-coded list in Go.
summary: Cycle 2509 shipped go/internal/faketmux/contract_test.go (commit b2486e62b), which starts real tmux without tmuxtest.Main. Its ship backstop tests the packages that import what it changed; internal/tmuxtest does not import faketmux, because TestEveryTmuxTestPackageUsesTheOrphanGuard scans the tree by file. So 2509 shipped green and main required CI run 44341646289 went red. The next lane that imported tmuxtest (cycle 2510) failed at ship on the red it did not cause.
title: the ship repo-contract backstop runs only importers, so a tree-scan guard misses a new package and main goes red
